whys: SA's variable rate phases in from 0% to 4.95% between $1.5m and $1.7m of Australian wages (lib/constants/payroll-tax.ts lines 139-143, and the SA HOW_NOTE on the state page), so 4% is not the lowest rate any employer pays.
